nodes.label: One adapter per SQLite database
nodes.rationale: The plugin has no multiprocess lease mechanism; the database must live on persistent storage.

nodes.label: Contact and message ID deduplication
nodes.rationale: Only a stable per-message identifier enables deduplication; message text or contact identity alone must not collapse legitimate repeated messages.

nodes.label: HTTP 202 is a persisted receipt
nodes.source_location: Phản hồi HTTP và trạng thái
nodes.rationale: Acceptance proves the event was committed to SQLite, not that AI processing or delivery has completed.

nodes.label: Crash recovery can duplicate replies
nodes.rationale: A process may die after an upstream send is accepted but before completion is recorded; recovery therefore cannot promise exactly-once delivery.

nodes.label: Retry only explicit HTTP 429 rejection
nodes.rationale: Timeouts, 5xx responses and unreadable responses can follow accepted sends, so automatic replay risks duplicate messages. Long Retry-After penalties are returned rather than retried early.

nodes.label: Processing watchdog pauses ingress
nodes.rationale: If no completion arrives within the configured timeout, accepting further events could overlap a stuck turn; return 503 and retain the processing event for inspection.
